question: How many members are actively enrolled with a health plan today (May 27, 2030) and attributed to a primary care practice?
interpretation: All 4,115 roster identities (deep-chart and population segments); identity-matched records received on or before 2030-05-27 only. Superseded records (any record named in another record's supersedes) are excluded so only current versions count. Use payer enrollment spans (current versions). Active = coverage_start on or before 2030-05-27 and coverage_end null, 9999-12-31 or on/after 2030-05-27. Attributed = attribution_practice_id present. Count distinct patients.

question: Break down our enrolled membership on January 1, 2030 by insurance product. How many members did each product have?

question: What was the medical PMPM (plan paid dollars per member per month) for our Medicare Advantage members in calendar year 2029?
interpretation: All 4,115 roster identities (deep-chart and population segments); identity-matched records received on or before 2030-05-27 only. Denominator: member months = distinct (patient, month) pairs where a current medicare_advantage enrollment span covers the first day of the month, January-December 2029 (null coverage_end = open). Rounded to cents.

question: Which patients are frequent ED users, meaning 4 or more emergency department visits in the last 12 months (May 28, 2029 through May 27, 2030)? Count visits from every source we receive: hospital ADT feeds, our EHR encounters, and claims.

De-duplicate across sources by patient + calendar date: one visit per patient per day.
